# Data Source cifs_share_acl

Retrieves one access control entry from a CIFS share.

## Related ONTAP commands

```commandline
* vserver cifs share access-control show
```

## Supported Platforms

* On-prem ONTAP system 9.6 or higher
* Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netapp-ontap_cifs_share_acl" "protocols_cifs_share_acl" {
  # required to know which system to interface with
  cx_profile_name = "cluster4"
  svm_name        = "d_svm"
  share_name      = "test"
  user_or_group   = "Everyone"
  type            = "windows"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name
- `share_name` (String) Name of the CIFS share that owns this ACL
- `svm_name` (String) Name of the SVM that owns the CIFS share
- `type` (String) Type of the user or group. Valid values are `windows`, `unix_user`, and `unix_group`.
- `user_or_group` (String) User or group name in the CIFS share access control list

### Read-Only

- `permission` (String) Access rights that the user or group has on the CIFS share. Possible values are `full_control`, `read`, `change`, and `no_access`.
